parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.topics, s.name as source_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.status = 'scored' AND a.category_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.created_at ASC LIMIT 20
UPDATE articles SET category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = '{{ $json.category }}' LIMIT 1), status = 'approved', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.article_id }}'::uuid
